name: cube-highways-backend
description: Custom Node.js CMS Backend for Cube Highways with AdminJS, GraphQL, MongoDB, and AWS S3

scripts.build:
node -e "console.log('
🔍 Validating JavaScript syntax...
'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); let hasError = false; function checkSyntax(dir) { const files = fs.readdirSync(dir); files.forEach(file => { const filePath = path.join(dir, file); const stat = fs.statSync(filePath); if (stat.isDirectory() && file !== 'node_modules') { checkSyntax(filePath); } else if (file.endsWith('.js')) { try { execSync('node --check ' + filePath, { stdio: 'pipe' }); console.log('✅', filePath); } catch (err) { console.error('❌', filePath); console.error(err.stderr.toString()); hasError = true; } } }); } checkSyntax('./src'); if (hasError) { console.error('
❌ Build validation failed! Syntax errors found.
'); process.exit(1); } console.log('
✅ Build validation passed! No syntax errors found.
');"

author: Cube Highways
